name: ESP K300 Raptor (ESP Raptor, 300 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC w/tip, printed ".320 est.". With the tip installed, determined at 250 yards (page footnote). Marked est.: estimated; the page states no accuracy. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 8, Enhanced System Projectile (ESP): Caliber .423, Grains 300, Minimum Required Twist 1-14", Part Number ESP K300 Raptor, G1 BC w/o tip TBD, G1 BC w/tip .320 est., OAL w/o tip 1.268", OAL w/tip 1.581", Bullet Projection w/o tip .380", Bullet Projection w/tip .693", Blunt Trauma Base™ ~ Retained Weight (grains) 221

note: G1 BC w/o tip is printed "TBD". Also printed: OAL w/o tip 1.268" (the length stored is with the tip). Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: w/o tip .380"; w/tip .693".
